newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Russia wants to refine oil in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Russia wants to refine oil in Brazil.

text.p: A Russian trade mission has been negotiating with Brazil's state oil monopoly Petrobras the possibility of refining Russian oil in Brazil, a company spokeswoman said.
She said Petrobras was still studying the proposal to see if and how it could accomodate the Russian request. She could not comment on the amount of oil Russia hopes to refine in Brazil.
Petrobras' refineries are currently processing 1.5 million barrels per day (bpd) to cover domestic consumption which is expected to expand 6.2 percent this year to more than 1.5 million bpd.
Russia is the world's third largest crude oil producer with output running at 6.2 million bpd and total Russian oil production for 1996 forecast at 303 million tonnes.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
